SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Early Civilizatio n together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.

Values:
• Respect: learners accommodate each other’s ideas as they brainstorm in groups on the differences between various species of early

humans and when they existed and share in class.
